freeze_statement: Re-freeze after the author-directed GenAI disclosure amendment resolving the three disclosure findings of the 2026-08-01 repository transparency audit. No number, rank, p-value, test, standing, or registered outcome changes; both supplementary artifacts are byte-identical to the pass-29 mint and only four tracked files move. (D-001) ChatGPT (OpenAI) is now named alongside Claude (Opus 4.6, 4.8 and 5.0; Anthropic) in the Use-of-GenAI statement, the Acknowledgments and the methods-level sentence: the manuscript had withheld it under MDPI's superficial-editing exemption, but the repository documents substantive ChatGPT review passes whose applied findings changed statistical language and method descriptions, and the author confirmed that broader scope. No version is stated for ChatGPT because the author-recalled strings were never verified; naming an unverifiable version was judged worse than naming none. (D-002) The affirmative scope is widened from 'background and explanatory passages' to expository prose throughout the manuscript restating findings the authors had already established, plus the internal pre-submission review use. (D-004) The three disclosure loci are harmonized on the word 'analysis': the methods sentence and Acknowledgments no longer deny AI contribution to 'the analysis' - a denial the tree strained, since AI-co-authored commits touched analysis TOOLING - and instead deny designing or executing any experiment, producing or computing any reported number, and generating the statistical method. Every denial remains true and now matches the repository. The absolute denials of the pass-29 wording are preserved rather than softened. Governance: AG-0007 amended with its original determination retained verbatim and marked superseded. Folded in: HYG-14 (placeholder ORCID macros in supplementary.tex replaced with the real iDs; unused, so the supplement is byte-identical) and HYG-12 (the forbidden-token rule restated to the scope actually in force). All five artifacts byte-identical across two consecutive builds at the pinned epochs; B1 = 41 pp, B2 = 22,533 words, inside the CR-0021 caps; gates green (hygiene FULL, parity 726/0, provenance, doc-consistency, C1-C5, bindings, labels, docx 33/33 both, tests 601+2).
